name: draft
body:
## What's New

Added 394 new stock brushes in 37 sets, each ProCraft's own; the earlier brushes stay, with your changes, in a Legacy set
Added new Adjustments, Selection, Transform, Paint, Smudge, Erase and Layers icons in the top bar - PR #178 by lork-fork
Added zooming and panning in the Drawing Guide editor - issue #184
Added support for Android 8 and 9 tablets - issue #239
Added Linux builds for 64-bit ARM - issue #240
Added the frame's width and height by your finger while resizing in Crop & Resize - issues #231, #250
Added Save to Gallery to the share sheet on Android - issue #232
Added Canvas Orientation Memory: the gallery shows an artwork turned as its canvas was left - issue #256
Added Rename to a brush's menu, held in the library - issue #253
Added pinching two fingers in on a brush library to show every library, and out on one to open it - issue #251
Fixed imported Photoshop brushes drawing plain and smooth: their textures, dual brushes, scattering and jitters now come in - issue #189
Fixed the pen button set to erase while held not erasing on some tablets - issue #193
Fixed pen strokes' width changing abruptly where the taper ends - issue #194
Fixed the Windows app freezing when sharing or importing - issue #197
Fixed the interface looking blurry and washed out on some Android tablets, with a new Wide Color switch in Settings - issues #179, #202, #208
Fixed vector layers with many strokes lagging and crashing - issue #209
Fixed lag on Android, most of all on lower-end tablets and large canvases - issue #222
Fixed Transform doing nothing with a group chosen - issues #224, #252
Fixed the canvas not opening on older graphics chips: everything works there now - issue #229
Fixed imported brushes with their own tips showing no shape under the pen - issue #236
Fixed Liquify's undo taking back the whole session: it now goes a stroke at a time - issue #238
Fixed Automatic selection reusing an old read after a drag was cut short - issue #243
Fixed smudge and wet brushes trailing behind the pen on some devices - issue #249
Fixed pen pressure stopping after switching windows with a Wacom or other WinTab tablet - issue #257
Fixed the perspective guide adding a vanishing point at any touch, and added Delete on a tapped point - issue #254
Fixed Selection, Uncombine and Add Frame problems, and the Gesture controls list not showing that it scrolls - issues #117, #181
Fixed the desktop app's selection and transform bars overlapping in a narrow window - issue #223

Added text styles for chosen letters - Discord
Added the canvas settling onto a straight angle when let go within 5° of one - Discord
Added the pen's second side button to Gesture controls, and Ctrl+Y as redo - Discord
Added sharing a stack or several artworks as one PDF, and Share, Duplicate and Delete on a swiped stack - Discord
Fixed time-lapses saying they can't be read after an update: earlier recordings come back whole - Discord
Fixed the Windows app taking half a minute to start, or crashing, on Intel graphics - Discord
Fixed sharing from the gallery crashing on some graphics drivers - Discord
Fixed pen pressure missing on some WinTab tablets (such as Huion), and Windows Ink's ripples over the canvas - Discord
Fixed smudge and wet brushes refusing to work on large canvases, and touching pixels outside a selection - Discord
Fixed imported brush libraries going missing if the app closed soon after importing - Discord
Fixed Crop & Resize blurring the artwork, and Fit to Canvas losing a turn or flip - Discord
Fixed the selection's bands staying on while transforming, and Color Fill filling at once - Discord
Fixed clipping masks over soft-edged layers showing a pale fringe - Discord
Fixed imported Krita brushes looking unlike they do in Krita - Discord
Fixed glaze, blending, dual and wet-edge brushes building up and blending wrongly - Discord
Fixed keyboard shortcuts going off while typing, and the keyboard showing under the text style sheet on Android - Discord
Fixed dragging a colour from the top bar pulling down the notification shade on Android - Discord
Fixed the desktop app slowing down after a long time-lapse, and pauses while saving very large canvases - Discord

Fixed marker and glaze brushes drawing too faintly, and many stock brushes now look nearer their own strokes
Fixed brushes from older brush files drawing with the wrong defaults, tilt, grain depth and finger pressure
Fixed the Smudge tool ignoring a brush's Smudge Pull
Fixed tapered brushes leaving gaps, pressure curves acting before stabilisation, and pens without tilt drawing as if leaning
Fixed the side bar's sliders: a tap on the track jumps there, and dragging out to the side moves it finer
Added the modify button (Alt) to the keyboard shortcut lists, and new icons for the Layers + menu

## Hotfixes

Fixed the app using far more memory, and lagging or crashing, with big brush libraries - issue #219
Fixed pen drag-scrolling in Brush Studio and Plugins on Windows - issue #196
Fixed the brush cursor not turning with the pen's tilt on Windows - issue #199
Fixed pen pressure dropping out at the start of strokes on Windows - issue #205
Fixed a pen painting while it hovers just above the screen - issue #131
Fixed the app freezing ("isn't responding") after drawing for a while on Android - Discord
Fixed slow lines wobbling on Windows, most of all zoomed out - Discord
Fixed the floating colour window covering the panels and the side bar - Discord
Fixed crashes and freezes when switching brush libraries or sets - Discord
Fixed a start-up crash that could repeat after an update on some tablets - Discord
Fixed a two-finger undo right after lifting the pen sometimes doing nothing, and an error during a touch closing the app
Added Share log under Actions > Help, so a crash can be sent to us

## Plugins

Added a Krita brushes plugin, and plugins can now bring brush engines of their own; similar plugins are joined into one with a switch for each, your settings coming along; each off until you turn it on in Prefs > Plugins:

1. Krita brushes: Krita presets and bundles draw with Krita's own engines, MyPaint brushes, SVG tips and thick paint, with a Krita brush studio
2. Brush engines: a plugin can draw the brushes it imports and give them a studio of their own
3. Phone layout: keeps the interface clear of the status bar and the camera cutout
4. Keyboard shortcuts: keys for zooming, fitting, turning and panning the canvas, on Android too, and no longer switching itself off - issue #213
5. ColorDrop tools: fills by all layers no longer leak past light or coloured lines - issue #212
6. QuickShape curves: curves keep their sharp turns and S-bends, an anchor dragged takes its controls along, and long curves edit faster - PR #246 by wesleydanieell
7. Colour triangle: a hue ring around the triangle, and a floating colour window with the picker alone - Discord
8. Interface: sizes for the floating panels, menus, side bar, top bar and panels each - Discord
9. Settings with a few named choices open a menu of their choices, not a slider - Discord

name: v0.0.6-beta
body:
## What's New

Fixed the desktop app crashing or closing at start on PCs with Intel graphics - issues #37, #102
Fixed black boxes and solid-looking strokes on Samsung tablets with Exynos graphics - issue #153
Fixed brush strokes losing their thin tapered ends - issue #122
Fixed the thinnest brush sizes drawing too thick - issue #100
Fixed see-through specks in some combined brushes, and imported brushes drawing much nearer their own look: faint second tips, dotted tips and paper grains - issue #150
Fixed the Brush Studio's drawing pad drawing at the same size whatever the brush's maximum size - issue #162
Fixed copy and paste between canvases of different sizes cutting the drawing off - issue #101
Fixed blurs and other adjustments painting outside an alpha locked layer, and Liquify now leaves such a layer alone - issue #113
Fixed the smudge tool moving paint outside the selection - issue #129
Fixed the floating colour panel not moving and its buttons not responding - issues #108, #161
Fixed the interface showing mirrored on tablets set to a right-to-left language - issue #160
Fixed the first artwork after starting taking seconds to open, and artworks with many brushes imported opening slowly - issues #106, #159
Fixed a turned canvas's jagged edges and its stretched zoom from the gallery - issues #158, #171
Fixed blocky steps in the slider glass and a white flash opening a canvas with a coloured background - issues #124, #125
Fixed the brush cursor flickering over the top bar - issue #175
Fixed Automatic selection ignoring the reference layer - issue #169
Fixed narrow windows, the Reference window's Face tab and a Linux touchscreen with a resting hand - issues #80, #91, #147
Added brush libraries: several libraries of brush sets to switch between, make, rename, duplicate or delete, each shared as one file, and the default library restored beside your own - issues #19, #156
Added Uncombine for combined brushes, and a question before the Brush Studio's reset buttons - issues #154, #155
Added a pen button that erases only while held (Gesture controls > Erase), and the Huawei M-Pencil's double-tap - issues #104, #172
Added Android 9 support (Fire tablets, Galaxy Tab S3) and Liquify's size ring on Android - issues #110, #157
Fixed QuickShape on smoothed brushes and the Brush Studio on short screens - PRs #65 by lashmanRB, #140 by wesleydanieell
Fixed the washed-out desktop window on Linux, and the background row opens colours on the desktop - PRs #94, #97 by zednaked

Added palm rejection: a resting hand neither draws nor moves the canvas while the pen is near - Discord
Added the colour models on Android: the disc, Classic and Value in HSB, HLS, HSY′ or OKLab - Discord
Added pen pressure on Windows with Windows Ink turned off (WinTab), F11 for full screen and the on-screen keyboard on Windows tablets - Discord
Fixed layers lost after cropping a canvas (they come back), and a layer that can't be read is never saved over: its file is kept and the app says which layer - Discord
Fixed imported Krita brushes losing their tips, textures and masking brushes, and Krita and GIMP brushes drawing softer or harder than in their own apps - Discord
Fixed imported Clip Studio brushes losing textures, patterns, ribbons, pressure and tapers, spray brushes scattering, and .sutg groups import - Discord
Fixed small tips from imported brushes drawing in big blocks, and large tips looking soft - Discord
Fixed lag and freezes with many brushes imported, after a long stroke, while undoing and while transforming - Discord
Fixed fast strokes coming out with corners on Windows, and the desktop's layer limit now grows with the computer's memory - Discord
Fixed the text style bar not showing above the keyboard on Android 10 tablets - Discord
Added the missing Combine Modes: Subtract, Divide and Linear Height - Discord

Added a signed and notarized Mac download
Added ColorDrop's stretchy drag, its fill spreading in from where it lands, and Frame and Page names for new frames and pages
Added messages when the brush library or a time-lapse can't be saved on a full disk, and a notice when the 32-bit Android app runs on a 64-bit tablet
Fixed watery brushes missing their wet rim, exported pattern brushes drawing plain noise, and imported brushes' sizes shrinking after a restart
Fixed drawing hitching with the Layers panel open, and the desktop taking ten seconds or more to show the first canvas on Direct3D 12
Fixed many smaller brush, layer, transform and desktop problems

## Plugins

Added Plugins that add buttons, panels and kinds of layer, each off until you turn it on in Prefs > Plugins:

1. Vector layers: layers whose strokes stay editable and sharp at any zoom, with every brush: select, move, recolour, fill, snap shapes, nudge with Smudge, erase softly or cut, and share as SVG (THIS PLUGIN IS WIP)
2. Keyboard shortcuts: change any of the app's shortcuts, on the desktop and with a keyboard on Android
3. Brush sounds: a sound as you draw, by the brush, or recordings of your own
4. Tweening: Animation Assist draws the frame between two frames
5. Paper texture: paper with a grain behind a layer - issue #112
6. Grid layer: a layer with a grid in the brush colour
7. QuickShape curves: a stroke that bends more than once snaps to a curve you can reshape
8. Colour triangle: Classic picks in a triangle
9. Interface colour: the app's blue in a colour of your own
10. Radial symmetry segments: 2 to 32 parts instead of 8
11. ColorDrop fills by all layers: fills stop at lines on every layer you see
12. Opacity of picked layers: one picked layer's opacity changes them all
13. Panels stay open: painting with a panel open leaves it open
14. Hide undo notices: undo and redo without the notice at the top
15. Brush randomiser: a Randomise button in the Brush Studio

Plugins can now add buttons that change your artwork (asking first, one undo each), panels of their own, the colour picker drawn their way, and kinds of layer the app draws with its own brushes
